products.description: A unique design and practical storage solution for homes and offices, the Adesso Swizzle Coat Rack presents a slim profile, yet can handle several coats, jackets, backpacks and hats on its eight pegs that are placed all around the pole body. Eight coat hooks are staggered on the pole for convenient hanging. Coat rack is crafted of metal for durability and long-term use. Each hook has an 11 lb. weight capacity.

products.description: This walnut coat rack combines functionality and style, perfect for keeping your space organized. Its open design allows you to hang various clothes and small items freely, helping maintain indoor tidiness. The special area for small accessories, like scarves, hair ties, and bags, makes it easy to find and match your outfits. With 360° silent casters and brakes, you can move it around effortlessly and lock it in place securely. PPEDKS
